reason: Plant fiber and water seem like a useful starting point for making the paper needed for paintings.
expectation: I expect wet pulp or another intermediate for paper.

alternatives.reason: Breaking glass might help make the mosaic, but I want to start with paper.

effect: The pulp is ready for the next stage of making paper.
reason: Cloth may help press or dry the pulp into paper for painting.
expectation: I expect paper or a further paper-making intermediate.

effect: The paper is ready, so I can work toward making paint or the gallery.
reaction: Making paper from the pulp was a straightforward progression.
reason: Dye and a bowl may produce paint for the paper.
expectation: I expect paint or a prepared dye for painting.

alternatives.reason: Stone and brick might start the gallery, but I want to prepare the artwork first.

effect: The paint is ready to use with the paper.
reason: Painting the paper should create artwork for the gallery.
expectation: I expect a painting or picture.

effect: The picture is ready for display, so I can work on the gallery structure.
reason: Stone and brick seem useful for building a gallery.
expectation: I expect a building or structural intermediate for the gallery.

alternatives.reason: Glass and stone might make pieces for the mosaic, but I want to finish the gallery first.

effect: The stone and brick made an arch, which may form part of the gallery.
reason: Adding planks to the arch seems like the next step toward a gallery building.
expectation: I expect a gallery structure or another building intermediate.

effect: The arcade provides a sheltered, daylit place to display the picture.
reaction: The explanation of the roof and open sides made the structure clear.
reason: Adding the picture to the arcade should complete the gallery.
expectation: I expect a gallery displaying the picture.

effect: The gallery is complete, leaving the mosaic goal.
reaction: The picture completed the gallery as expected.
reason: Glass and stone may make small glass pieces for the mosaic.
expectation: I expect glass fragments or another mosaic material.

alternatives.reason: Glass and planks might also contribute to the mosaic, but stone seems useful for breaking glass.

effect: The glass and stone made mosaic pieces, ready to be set into a backing.
reason: Clay seems suitable for holding the mosaic pieces together.
expectation: I expect a mosaic or a clay base with the pieces set into it.

effect: The mosaic completed the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: Setting the glass pieces into clay was a satisfying, clear finish.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the arcade was most worthwhile because its explanation made the gallery's sheltered, daylit structure easy to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing paint from dye and a bowl felt routine, with little explanation of the transformation.

surprise.text: The arch became an open-sided arcade with a roof, which clarified what kind of gallery I was building.

arbitrary.text: Combining dye with a bowl to make paint felt a little arbitrary; the bowl's role was not explained.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see more constructions explained like the arcade, though the predictable material steps were less engaging.
